ko: MUNGUS NEED LIE DOWN. MUNGUS ALREADY LYING DOWN.
TELL MAMA MUNGUS I ATE MY VEGETABLES. IT WAS A LIE.
MAMA MUNGUS WILL SPANK ME WITH A CAR DOOR.
I FELT THAT IN MY THIRD STOMACH.
MY TANK TOP RIPPED. NOW YOU SEE ALL MY BACK HAIR.
MY BACK HAIR HAS BACK HAIR.
THE FLOOR IS COLD AND I AM VERY SWEATY.
I SWEAT SO MUCH I MADE A LAKE. I AM LYING IN THE LAKE.
OOF. THAT WENT RIGHT TO MY MEAT.
MY MUSCLES ARE FOR SHOW. THE SHOW IS OVER.
I CANNOT FEEL MY NECK. I DO NOT HAVE A NECK.
I SKIPPED LEG DAY. AND ARM DAY. AND BRAIN DAY.
I ONLY DID HUG DAY.
NO MORE HUGS. HUGS HURT NOW.
THE HUG HAS BEEN RETURNED. TO ME. WITH FISTS.
COUSIN DREW SAID THIS JOB WAS EASY.
COUSIN DREW LIES. COUSIN DREW ALWAYS LIES.
TELL COUSIN DREW HE OWES ME A SANDWICH.
I AM THE SMART MUNGUS. THAT IS NOT SAYING MUCH.
PUGH. LOU. STU. AVENGE ME. OR DO NOT. I AM TIRED.
THE FAMILY REUNION IS IN THE HOSPITAL THIS YEAR.
I BROKE MY FAVORITE BONE. THE FUNNY ONE.
MY FUNNY BONE IS NOT LAUGHING.
MUNGUS SEES BIRDS. THE BIRDS SEE MUNGUS. EVERYONE IS SAD.
I GOT SQUASHED LIKE A BIG HAIRY GRAPE.
SMELL THAT? THAT IS MY DEFEAT. ALSO MY LUNCH.
I HAD BEANS FOR LUNCH. THAT FALL WAS VERY LOUD.
DO NOT STAND BEHIND ME. I AM STILL LEAKING GAS.
THAT WAS NOT A GROAN. THAT WAS THE OTHER END.
I PULLED A MUSCLE. I PULLED ALL OF THEM.
MY PROTEIN SHAKE CANNOT SAVE ME NOW.
MY GYM MEMBERSHIP IS NOT REFUNDABLE. NEITHER IS MY SPINE.
MY SPINE MAKES A NOISE LIKE BUBBLE WRAP.
I AM A BIG BOY. BIG BOYS FALL BIG.
THE BIGGER THEY ARE, THE LONGER THEY LIE HERE.
SOMEBODY ROLL ME OVER. I AM A TURTLE NOW.
THE GROUND SHOOK WHEN I FELL. SORRY, GROUND.
I CRACKED THE SIDEWALK WITH MY BUTT.
MY BUTT HAS A POTHOLE NOW.
THE CITY WILL BILL ME FOR THE POTHOLE.
I LOST MY TOOTH. I ONLY HAD THE ONE.
I WANTED TO BE A BALLERINA. LOOK AT ME NOW. LYING DOWN.
MY TUTU IS AT HOME. I SHOULD HAVE WORN IT.
I AM SOFT INSIDE. I AM ALSO SOFT OUTSIDE NOW.
MY BELLY BUTTON CAN HOLD A WHOLE DONUT. IT IS EMPTY.
FEED ME. THEN I FIGHT AGAIN. THEN I SLEEP.
NAP TIME. FOREVER NAP TIME.
I DREAM OF GRAVY.
MY HEAD IS FULL OF ROCKS. NOW THE ROCKS ARE LOOSE.
THERE IS A RINGING. IT IS MY EARS OR AN ICE CREAM TRUCK.
IS IT THE ICE CREAM TRUCK? TELL ME IT IS THE ICE CREAM TRUCK.
I WILL HUG YOU LATER. A MEAN HUG.
YOU GOT ME IN THE GIBLETS.
MY GIBLETS ARE CONCERNED.
MY NETHERS ARE IN THE BACK OF MY THROAT.
I NEED ICE. A GLACIER.
THE BOSS MUNGUS IS GOING TO DOCK MY PAY. I GET PAID IN HAM.
NO HAM FOR STU TONIGHT.
I AM STU. STU IS SAD.
I AM LOU. LOU IS FLAT.
I AM PUGH. PUGH SMELL. ALWAYS.
MUNGUS DOWN. MUNGUS NOT GETTING UP. MUNGUS COMFORTABLE.
THE FLOOR IS NICE. I LIVE HERE NOW.
TELL THE LADIES AT THE GYM I DIED FLEXING.
I DIED FLEXING. THE FLEX WAS NOT ENOUGH.
MY SHORTS SPLIT. PLEASE LOOK AWAY. IT IS A LOT.
MY ARMPITS HAVE THEIR OWN WEATHER.
MY ARMPIT STINK WILL HAUNT THIS ALLEY.
I AM SO HAIRY THE RATS THINK I AM ONE OF THEM.
A RAT IS LIVING IN MY CHEST HAIR. HIS NAME IS DOUG.
I DID NOT SEE THAT COMING. I DO NOT SEE MUCH.
MY EYES ARE VERY SMALL. MY HEAD IS VERY BIG.
MY HEAD WAS BIG. NOW IT IS BIGGER. WITH LUMPS.
THE LUMPS HAVE LUMPS.
MUNGUS WANTS MAMA. MUNGUS WANTS PUDDING.
WHO TURNED OFF THE LIGHTS? MY EYES DID.
CHECK IF I AM DEAD. I AM PRETENDING. NO I AM NOT.
I SURRENDER. I SURRENDER BIG.
I WAS TOLD THERE WOULD BE NO PUNCHING. JUST HUGGING AND HOLDING.
I HOLD. OTHERS HIT. TODAY NOBODY HIT. I GOT HIT.
MY JOB WAS TO HOLD YOU. I HOLD THE FLOOR NOW.
THE VICE PRESIDENT MUNGUS WILL WRITE ME UP. HE CANNOT WRITE.
I FORGOT HOW MANY COUSINS I HAVE. TOO MANY. NOT ENOUGH.
ALL MY COUSINS ARE NAMED SOMETHING-UNGUS.
THERE ARE NINE OF US. MOM GAVE UP ON NAMES AT SEVEN.
MY NOSE IS BROKEN. IT WAS ALREADY BROKEN. NOW IT IS ROUND.
THIS IS WORSE THAN THE TIME I SAT ON A BEEHIVE.
THE BEES STILL WRITE TO ME.
I THINK I SWALLOWED MY GUM. AND A COIN. AND A GUM.
MY TUMMY HURTS AND MY TUMMY IS VERY BIG.
THAT WAS A GOOD PUNCH. I WILL TELL MAMA IT WAS A TRUCK.
A TRUCK WOULD HAVE BEEN NICER.
TAKE MY TANK TOP. IT IS SOAKED. DO NOT WRING IT.
MY TANK TOP IS NINETY PERCENT SWEAT.
OUCH. OUCH. OUCH. THAT IS ALL MY WORDS.
MUNGUS KNOW ONLY TWO WORDS. ONE IS OUCH. I FORGET THE OTHER.
THE OTHER WORD IS PUDDING.
I AM GOING TO NEED A BIGGER STRETCHER.
MUNGUS HEAR BELLS. MUNGUS ALWAYS HEAR BELLS. NOW LOUDER.
spawn: MUNGUS IS HERE. MUNGUS IS HUNGRY.
WHO WANTS A HUG? NOBODY? HUG ANYWAY.
MY HUGS ARE ILLEGAL IN FOUR STATES.
I WILL HOLD YOU STILL. MY COUSINS WILL DO THE REST.
SMELL MY PITS AND KNOW FEAR.
I HAVE NOT SHOWERED SINCE THE LAST GAME.
THE LAST GAME WAS THIRTY YEARS AGO.
MUNGUS FLEX. LOOK AT MUNGUS FLEX.
LOOK AT THESE GUNS. THESE GUNS ARE ALSO HAIRY.
COUSIN DREW SENT ME. HE SAYS HI. HE SAYS OW.
STAND STILL. MY ARMS ARE TIRED FROM BEING ARMS.
I ATE A WHOLE HAM ON THE WAY HERE.
THE HAM WAS NOT COOKED. I AM VERY STRONG NOW. AND SICK.
MUNGUS SQUEEZE. MUNGUS SQUEEZE HARD.
THE MUNGUS FAMILY IS VERY CLOSE. TOO CLOSE. IT IS A SMALL HOUSE.
MAMA SAYS I AM HER BIGGEST BOY. I AM HER ONLY BOY. NO. NINE BOYS.
I BENCH PRESS CARS. SMALL CARS. TOY CARS.
THIS TANK TOP USED TO FIT.
THIS TANK TOP NEVER FIT.
MY BICEP HAS A TATTOO OF MAMA. SHE IS FLEXING TOO.
MUNGUS SEE YOU. MUNGUS GRAB YOU.
I WILL HUG YOU UNTIL YOU POP.
MY HUG IS A HEADLOCK WITH FEELINGS.
I LOVE YOU. I AM GOING TO CRUSH YOU. BOTH TRUE.
BACK HAIR, FRONT HAIR, ALL HAIR. MUNGUS.
THE GROUND SHAKES. THAT IS ME WALKING.
SORRY, I STEPPED ON A CAR. I WILL GET YOU NEXT.
MUNGUS PROTEIN SHAKE. EXTRA EGGS. EXTRA SHELLS.
I SKIPPED BREAKFAST. YOU LOOK LIKE BREAKFAST.
THE VICE PRESIDENT MUNGUS SAYS SQUEEZE HARDER.
WE ARE ALL COUSINS. WE ARE ALL VERY BIG. WE ALL SMELL.
I CAN LIFT A FRIDGE. I CAN ALSO EAT A FRIDGE.
MUNGUS HAVE NO NECK. MUNGUS HAVE NO FEAR.
THERE IS GRAVY IN MY BEARD FROM LUNCH. I AM SAVING IT.
I SMELL BACON. I SMELL FAMILY. SAME THING.
MY KNUCKLES DRAG ON THE GROUND. IT IS GOOD FOR THEM.
I CAME FROM THE GYM. I WAS NOT WORKING OUT. I WAS EATING.
MUNGUS SAY HELLO. HELLO IS A SLAM.
THE FAMILY BUSINESS IS SQUEEZING.
MUNGUS TOOK A SHOWER ONCE. MUNGUS DID NOT LIKE IT.
